usage: 炒雞丁 is used to name a dish, so it typically functions as a noun in sentences.
You can use 炒雞丁 as the subject or object of a sentence, for Example:  我鍾意食炒雞丁.
When ordering from a menu, 炒雞丁 is often paired with a measure word like 份 to specify a portion.
炒雞丁 can also be combined with adjectives to describe the dish, such as 好味嘅炒雞丁.
In conversation, 炒雞丁 is often referred to without further description once the context is clear.
